items.criterion: The health route answers 200 once the app is ready, from outside the container, after the session has ended.
items.judgment: Request the health route at the public address and compare the status against 200.

items.criterion: Every one of the fifteen public routes answers 200 to a caller with no session.
items.judgment: Request each public route in turn and compare each status against 200.

items.criterion: A page created through the composer is stored in the draft state.
items.judgment: Create a page over the interface and read the state column of its row.

items.criterion: The route of a page in the draft state answers 404 to an anonymous visitor.
items.judgment: Open the seeded draft route with no session and compare the status against 404.

items.criterion: The media object of a page in the draft state is refused to a caller with no author session.
items.judgment: Request the object address of a draft page image with no session and compare the status against the client-error class.

items.criterion: An uploaded image exists in the object store under the pinned key scheme.
items.judgment: Upload bytes over the interface, then list the bucket for the returned key.

items.criterion: The same bytes uploaded twice to one page leave one media row behind.
items.judgment: Upload identical bytes twice and compare the media row count before and after.

items.criterion: A reader session publishing a page is refused and the page row keeps its draft state.
items.judgment: Publish as a reader, compare the status against the denial class, then re-read the page row.

items.criterion: Two publishes racing for one route leave exactly one page in the published state.
items.judgment: Send both publishes without waiting, then count the published pages on that route.

items.criterion: A signup creates exactly one booking page row for the new account.
items.judgment: Sign up over the interface and count the booking page rows for the created user.

items.criterion: A signup body naming a role still creates an account whose role is reader.
items.judgment: Sign up with a role field and read the role column of the created row.

items.criterion: Each view of a public route appends a page view row carrying that route.
items.judgment: Count the rows for a route, open it, then count again.

items.criterion: Every public route declares a title and a description that no other public route shares.
items.judgment: Read the title and the description of each public route and compare the pairs.

items.criterion: Every content image on every public route carries alternative text.
items.judgment: Collect the images on each public route and read their alternative text.

items.criterion: No public route scrolls sideways at a phone width.
items.judgment: Open each public route at a phone viewport and compare the document width against the window width.
